thread.title: Apple Music to Surpass Spotify with 36 million paying subscriber; WSJ Report

author: Jasmin Chavez
title: Apple Music to Surpass Spotify with 36 million paying subscriber; WSJ Report
text:
February 5, 2018 Apple Music to Surpass Spotify with 36 million paying subscriber; WSJ Report 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)’s Music service should surpass popular Spotify in United States, in this summer, according to latest report of WSJ, reported on Sunday. The report reported claimed that Apple Music is growing at a faster pace, than Spotify and it could soon eclipse the service in popularity in the country. 
Spotify service has upwards of 70 million paid Premium subscribers, and it also maintains a large subscribers worldwide lead. Spotify has at least as many free listeners also, whereas Apple Inc. (AAPL) told the Wall Street Journal that it now has 36 million subscribers in total. And in spite of it, Apple being available in 115 markets versus Spotify’s 61. 
Reportedly, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is adding subscribers, at a rate of 5% per month versus Spotify’s 2 percent per month, as told by the Wall Street Journal. It was added by one of the sources, that Apple Music already has a slight advantage, if the people in free or discounted trial periods are included. 
The Apple Music has also other benefits, as it has preinstalled hundreds of millions of iPhones and iPads. Apple Music’s is also available on wide range on gadgets like, Android, Mac, PC, Apple TV, Apple Watch, and the vehicles which are equipped with CarPlay, Sonos, and HomePod. 
Apple Music simultaneously launched in more than 100 countries in 2015 while the Spotify music service expanded to the United States in 2011. Both music services offer its own individual which includes, the student plans for $4.99 per month, plans for $9.99 per month, and family plans sharable with up to six people for $14.99 per month, in terms of paid subscriptions.
